Bringing Beedrill to Life in 3D
Fast, fierce, and armed with powerful stingers, Beedrill is the final evolution of Weedle and a Bug/Poison-type Pokémon from the original Kanto region.
Known for protecting its territory in swarms, Beedrill can strike quickly with the poisonous stingers on its arms and tail.
A classic Gen 1 Pokémon brought to life as a 3D printed and hand-painted Pokémon card. #beedrill #pokemon #miniaturepainting #3dprinting #instareels
